description: Tokyo, Japan's bustling capital, mixes ultra-modern skyscrapers and neon-lit streets with historic temples and gardens. It is world-renowned for its culinary scene, safety, efficient transit, and distinct neighborhood cultures.
culture_tips: Avoid walking while eating; eat near food stands or dining areas.
Keep trash until you find a trash bin or return to your hotel, as public bins are rare.
Queue orderly when boarding trains and keep noise levels low.
